description: Source code implementing ASN.1 DER decoding functions for OpenSSL, specifically functions to decode ASN.1 data from BIO and FILE pointers.

methods.name: ASN1_item_d2i_bio
methods.description: Decodes ASN.1 data from a BIO stream into a structure, with an unlimited size limit.

methods.name: ASN1_item_d2i_fp
methods.description: Decodes ASN.1 data from a FILE stream into a structure, using a BIO wrapper.
